tools.name: hetu_read_blueprint
tools.title: 读取设定集 / Read story bible
tools.description: 读取当前或固定修订的作者设定集。Read the author's current or fixed story bible revision.

tools.name: hetu_write_draft
tools.title: 提交待审草稿 / Submit draft
tools.description: 保存调用方提供的文本，等待作者审核；不覆盖正式正文，不自动生成或检查。Save supplied text for author review; no generation, automatic validation or direct publication.

tools.name: hetu_extract_plot
tools.title: 整理剧情 / Extract plot
tools.description: 从固定原文提取结构候选；覆盖不足保留 partial，需要作者确认。Extract structural candidates from fixed source revisions; partial coverage requires author review.

tools.name: hetu_build_drama_skeleton
tools.title: 建立短剧骨架 / Build drama skeleton
tools.description: 从固定剧情整理分集场次，不生成台词、动作或镜头描述。Organize episodes and scenes from fixed plot evidence; no dialogue, action or shot generation.

tools.name: hetu_validate_blueprint
tools.title: 执行一致性检查 / Validate consistency
tools.description: 检查固定剧情修订；问题和未覆盖范围是报告结果，不是工具故障。Validate a fixed plot revision; findings and uncovered premises are report outcomes, not tool failures.

tools.name: hetu_list_workspace
tools.title: 查看授权工作区 / List workspace
tools.description: 读取启动时绑定的单一工作区和内容包。Read the single workspace and packages authorized at server startup. Discover documents and review feedback through resources.

tools.name: hetu_validate_draft
tools.title: 检查待审草稿 / Validate draft
tools.description: 检查固定草稿或其人工校正剧情并保存审核证据；不能批准草稿。Validate a fixed draft or its author-corrected plot and save review evidence; cannot approve drafts.

tools.name: hetu_commit_snapshot
tools.title: 准备或提交版本快照 / Prepare or commit snapshot
tools.description: 准备固定文件、HEAD与提交身份，返回pending；仅可执行已经由作者在本机批准的同一快照。不能自行批准、初始化、切分支、推送或执行hooks。Prepare fixed files, HEAD and identity with pending status; execution requires the author’s matching local approval. Cannot approve, initialize, switch branches, push or execute hooks.

tools.name: hetu_read_creative_task
tools.title: 读取本次创作任务 / Read creative task
tools.description: 读取连接绑定的固定任务、授权原文及参考候选；不能遍历其他章节、作品或任务。Read only the bound task, fixed authorized sources and reference candidates; no access to other documents, books or tasks.

tools.name: hetu_submit_creative_result
tools.title: 提交创作参考 / Submit creative references
tools.description: 提交固定任务的独立候选；改稿只接受允许范围内的 UTF-8 patches。不覆盖作者正文、不采纳或定稿。Submit independent candidates for the fixed task; revisions require UTF-8 patches within edit_scope. Cannot save author documents, adopt or finalize.

tools.name: hetu_open_task_view
tools.title: 查看任务局部选择 / Read task selection view
tools.description: 比较本任务参考方案。支持 MCP Apps 的宿主可展示局部选择面板；其他宿主返回同一任务数据。保存只记录偏好，不采纳正文或定稿。Compare references for this task, with an optional MCP Apps selection view. Other hosts receive the same task data. Preferences do not adopt or finalize content.

tools.name: hetu_save_task_selection
tools.title: 保存参考偏好 / Save reference preference
tools.description: 仅保存候选偏好和意见；不代表作者采纳、创建作品、选用封面或确认定稿。Save candidate preferences and comments only; never adopts text, creates a book, selects its cover or finalizes.
